---
title: "Dark brand listed first defaults to dark"
format: html
brand:
  dark: slate-brand.yml
  light: united-brand.yml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['body.quarto-dark', 'link.quarto-color-alternate']
        - []
---

Both brand files are valid and `dark` is listed first, so the page defaults to dark mode.
